chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I played Nereid's Ascension, killing Twig Slime (S) and Leaf Slime (S) while reducing Leaf Slime (M) to 16 HP, then played All Streams Flow to the Sea on Leaf Slime (M), reducing it to 7 HP.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered Nereid's Ascension followed by Coral Guard, trading 9 damage on Leaf Slime (M) for 5 Block.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up 5 Block and therefore some protection against damage in exchange for leaving the surviving enemy at 7 HP instead of 16 HP.
answers.q4_different_intent: Yes. If a surviving enemy had telegraphed a sufficiently large attack, I would have favored Nereid's Ascension followed by Coral Guard instead.
